title: Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.16182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. translated_title: 面向零样本文本分类的以标签为中心的知识检索
translated_abstract: 旗舰级大语言模型（LLM）提供了丰富的通用知识和强大的推理能力，但其高昂的推理成本和延迟限制了它们在大规模数据标注中的应用。我们研究了在具有语义含义的标签和任务描述条件下的零样本文本分类，无需任务特定的标注样本或分类器反馈。我们提出了 SLKR（语义标签知识检索，Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval），这是一个以标签为中心的检索增强生成框架，将离线知识构建与轻量级在线推理分离开来。在离线阶段，旗舰级大语言模型独立生成标签定义、检索关键词，以及针对潜在易混淆标签对的边界规则，从而构建出一个可复用的标签知识库。由于该构建过程作用于标签空间而非输入语料库，其一次性的旗舰模型使用成本可以在大规模推理中被摊销。在线阶段，混合式语义与词汇检索...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 SLKR 框架，通过将旗舰大语言模型的知识构建置于离线阶段的标签空间（而非输入语料）上，使一次性成本可在大规模推理中摊销，从而以轻量级在线混合检索实现低成本的零样本文本分类。
en_tdlr: SLKR is a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that amortizes the one-time cost of flagship LLM knowledge construction over the label space offline, enabling lightweight, cost-effective zero-shot text classification through hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval at inference time.
